caption:
Jami-Lee | Friendly English Tutor for Kids & Beginners | Introduction Video

Hi, I'm Teacher Jami-Lee! 👋 Watch this short video to meet your future English tutor and see how I make learning English fun, not scary.

In this video, you'll learn:
✔ A little about me and my teaching style
✔ How my lessons work: colourful, interactive and step by step
✔ How I help beginners and young learners speak with confidence

About me:
I'm a native English speaker from South Africa. I'm TEFL-trained and have a degree in Counselling & Psychology. I volunteer with Grade 2 learners in a reading club, and my lessons use picture-led slides, games and speaking practice, plus a hand puppet for younger students.

What to expect in a lesson with me:
A warm, patient, mistake-friendly space
Clear structure with lots of speaking practice
Lessons tailored to your goals and pace

Ready to start? Book a trial lesson with me and let's take your first step together! 😊
#ESLTeacher #EnglishTutor #LearnEnglish #TEFL #Onl

lines.text: Hello and welcome. My name is Jeremy Lee and I'm from beautiful Cape Town, South Africa.
It's so lovely to meet you. I'm a qualified TEFL teacher with a Bachelor of Applied Social Sciences in Counseling and Psychology,
as well as several years of experience in student support and online education.
My teaching style is warm, patient and interactive.
I want my students to feel comfortable making mistakes, asking questions and building confidence while learning English.
Together, we can work on speaking, pronunciation, vocabulary, grammar, reading and everyday conversation while tailoring lessons to your individual goals.
Whether you're learning English for school, work, travel or simply to become more confident,
I'm here to support and encourage you every step of the way.
So, let's learn, grow and have some fun together.
I can't wait to meet you. See you in class. Bye-bye.
